title: What causes cavities? - Mel Rosenberg
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】是什麼原因導致蛀牙？ ——梅爾·羅森伯格（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: When a team of archaeologists recently came across some 15,000 year-old human remains,
cues.en: When a team of archaeologists recently came across some 15,000 year-old human remains,
cues.zh: 近期有個考古團隊 找到了大約一萬五千歲的人類遺骸 他們有個饒富興味的發現

cues.text: they made an interesting discovery.
cues.en: they made an interesting discovery.
cues.zh: 他們有個饒富興味的發現 那些古代人的牙齒上，有許多坑洞

cues.text: The teeth of those ancient humans were riddled with holes.
cues.en: The teeth of those ancient humans were riddled with holes.
cues.zh: 那些古代人的牙齒上，有許多坑洞

cues.text: Their cavities were caused by the same thing that still plagues us today,
cues.en: Their cavities were caused by the same thing that still plagues us today,
cues.zh: 那些古代人的牙齒上，有許多坑洞 這些蛀洞的成因 和今日仍然困擾我們的蛀牙一樣

cues.text: specific tiny microbes that live in our mouths.
cues.en: specific tiny microbes that live in our mouths.
cues.zh: 和今日仍然困擾我們的蛀牙一樣 是由口腔裡的特定微生物所引起的 在我們出生後不久 這些微生物就已與我們同在

cues.text: These microbes are with us soon after birth.
cues.en: These microbes are with us soon after birth.
cues.zh: 在我們出生後不久 這些微生物就已與我們同在 通常是從母親的嘴傳給嬰兒

cues.text: We typically pick them up as babies from our mothers' mouths.
cues.en: We typically pick them up as babies from our mothers' mouths.
cues.zh: 通常是從母親的嘴傳給嬰兒 我們長出牙齒後

cues.text: And as our teeth erupt, they naturally begin to accumulate communities of bacteria.
cues.en: And as our teeth erupt, they naturally begin to accumulate communities of bacteria.
cues.zh: 我們長出牙齒後 自然地累積而成細菌的聚落 根據我們所吃的東西

cues.text: Depending on what we eat, and specifically how much sugar we consume,
cues.en: Depending on what we eat, and specifically how much sugar we consume,
cues.zh: 根據我們所吃的東西 特別是糖的數量

cues.text: certain microbes can overpopulate and cause cavities.
cues.en: certain microbes can overpopulate and cause cavities.
cues.zh: 特別是糖的數量 某些微生物會過度孳長而導致蛀牙 吃了高度含糖的食物

cues.text: Diets high in sugary foods cause an explosion of bacteria
cues.en: Diets high in sugary foods cause an explosion of bacteria
cues.zh: 吃了高度含糖的食物 會導致口腔裡的 「轉糖鏈球菌」爆炸性孳生

cues.text: called mutans streptococci in our mouths.
cues.en: called mutans streptococci in our mouths.
cues.zh: 會導致口腔裡的 「轉糖鏈球菌」爆炸性孳生 這些微生物和人類一樣喜愛糖

cues.text: Like humans, these microorganisms love sugar, using it as a molecular building block and energy source.
cues.en: Like humans, these microorganisms love sugar, using it as a molecular building block and energy source.
cues.zh: 這些微生物和人類一樣喜愛糖 用糖組成分子結構 並當作能量的來源 當微生物消耗糖分時

cues.text: As they consume it, the bacteria generate byproducts in the form of acids,
cues.en: As they consume it, the bacteria generate byproducts in the form of acids,
cues.zh: 當微生物消耗糖分時 細菌產生酸性的副產物 例如「乳酸」

cues.text: such as lactic acid.
cues.en: such as lactic acid.
cues.zh: 細菌產生酸性的副產物 例如「乳酸」

cues.text: Mutans streptococci are resistant to this acid, but unfortunately, our teeth aren't.
cues.en: Mutans streptococci are resistant to this acid, but unfortunately, our teeth aren't.
cues.zh: 例如「乳酸」 轉糖鏈球菌並不怕酸 但很不幸的，我們的牙齒怕酸 雖然人類的牙齒有一層 堅硬的「琺瑯質」保護層

cues.text: While each human tooth is coated in a hardy, protective layer of enamel,
cues.en: While each human tooth is coated in a hardy, protective layer of enamel,
cues.zh: 雖然人類的牙齒有一層 堅硬的「琺瑯質」保護層

cues.text: it's no match for acid.
cues.en: it's no match for acid.
cues.zh: 雖然人類的牙齒有一層 堅硬的「琺瑯質」保護層 但敵不過酸 隨著時間經過，鈣質礦物被溶解 使得琺瑯質保護層愈來愈薄

cues.text: That degrades the armor over time, leaching away its calcium minerals.
cues.en: That degrades the armor over time, leaching away its calcium minerals.
cues.zh: 隨著時間經過，鈣質礦物被溶解 使得琺瑯質保護層愈來愈薄 漸漸地，酸蝕穿了一條通道

cues.text: Gradually, acid wears down a pathway for bacteria into the tooth's secondary layer called the dentin.
cues.en: Gradually, acid wears down a pathway for bacteria into the tooth's secondary layer called the dentin.
cues.zh: 隨著時間經過，鈣質礦物被溶解 使得琺瑯質保護層愈來愈薄 漸漸地，酸蝕穿了一條通道 細菌進入被稱為 「牙本質」的牙齒內層 因為血管和神經 埋在封閉的牙齒深處

cues.text: Since blood vessels and nerves in our teeth are enclosed deep within,
cues.en: Since blood vessels and nerves in our teeth are enclosed deep within,
cues.zh: 因為血管和神經 埋在封閉的牙齒深處

cues.text: at this stage, the expanding cavity doesn't hurt.
cues.en: at this stage, the expanding cavity doesn't hurt.
cues.zh: 因為血管和神經 埋在封閉的牙齒深處 在此階段，逐漸擴大的 蛀牙區並不會產生疼痛

cues.text: But if the damage extends beyond the dentin, the bacterial invasion progresses
cues.en: But if the damage extends beyond the dentin, the bacterial invasion progresses
cues.zh: 在此階段，逐漸擴大的 蛀牙區並不會產生疼痛 但若損害擴大 超出了牙本質的範圍 持續侵入的細菌

cues.text: causing excruciating pain as the nerves become exposed.
cues.en: causing excruciating pain as the nerves become exposed.
cues.zh: 持續侵入的細菌 一旦碰到了神經 就會引起劇烈疼痛 如不進行治療 整個牙齒會受到感染

cues.text: Without treatment, the whole tooth may become infected and require removal
cues.en: Without treatment, the whole tooth may become infected and require removal
cues.zh: 如不進行治療 整個牙齒會受到感染 甚至需要被拔除 這全都是愛糖的細菌所導致的

cues.text: all due to those sugar-loving bacteria.
cues.en: all due to those sugar-loving bacteria.
cues.zh: 這全都是愛糖的細菌所導致的 食物含糖越多

cues.text: The more sugar our food contains, the more our teeth are put at risk.
cues.en: The more sugar our food contains, the more our teeth are put at risk.
cues.zh: 食物含糖越多 牙齒就越危險

cues.text: Those cavemen would hardly have indulged in sugary treats, however,
cues.en: Those cavemen would hardly have indulged in sugary treats, however,
cues.zh: 牙齒就越危險 然而，那些穴居人 應該很難沉溺於美味的糖 是什麼引起他們的蛀牙呢？

cues.text: so what caused their cavities?
cues.en: so what caused their cavities?
cues.zh: 是什麼引起他們的蛀牙呢？

cues.text: In meat-heavy diets, there would have been a low-risk of cavities developing
cues.en: In meat-heavy diets, there would have been a low-risk of cavities developing
cues.zh: 是什麼引起他們的蛀牙呢？ 偏重肉類的飲食，蛀牙的風險很低

cues.text: because lean meat contains very little sugar, but that's not all our early human ancestors ate.
cues.en: because lean meat contains very little sugar, but that's not all our early human ancestors ate.
cues.zh: 偏重肉類的飲食，蛀牙的風險很低 因為瘦肉含糖分極少 但人類的祖先不僅吃肉 穴居人也吃根莖類蔬菜 堅果和穀物

cues.text: Cavemen would also have consumed root vegetables, nuts, and grains,
cues.en: Cavemen would also have consumed root vegetables, nuts, and grains,
cues.zh: 穴居人也吃根莖類蔬菜 堅果和穀物 這些全都含有醣類（碳水化合物）

cues.text: all of which contain carbohydrates.
cues.en: all of which contain carbohydrates.
cues.zh: 這些全都含有醣類（碳水化合物） 當醣類遇到唾液中的酶時

cues.text: When exposed to enzymes in the saliva, carbohydrates get broken down into simpler sugars,
cues.en: When exposed to enzymes in the saliva, carbohydrates get broken down into simpler sugars,
cues.zh: 當醣類遇到唾液中的酶時 碳水化合物被分解成較簡單的糖

cues.text: which can become the fodder for those ravenous mouth bacteria.
cues.en: which can become the fodder for those ravenous mouth bacteria.
cues.zh: 碳水化合物被分解成較簡單的糖 成為那些嘴饞的口腔細菌的飼料

cues.text: So while ancient humans did eat less sugar compared to us,
cues.en: So while ancient humans did eat less sugar compared to us,
cues.zh: 成為那些嘴饞的口腔細菌的飼料 雖然古人吃的糖確實比我們少

cues.text: their teeth were still exposed to sugars.
cues.en: their teeth were still exposed to sugars.
cues.zh: 雖然古人吃的糖確實比我們少 他們的牙齒仍然暴露在糖分中

cues.text: That doesn't mean they were unable to treat their cavities, though.
cues.en: That doesn't mean they were unable to treat their cavities, though.
cues.zh: 他們的牙齒仍然暴露在糖分中 雖然如此，並不意味著 他們無法治療蛀牙

cues.text: Archaeological remains show that about 14,000 years ago,
cues.en: Archaeological remains show that about 14,000 years ago,
cues.zh: 雖然如此，並不意味著 他們無法治療蛀牙 考古遺跡顯示，大約一萬四千年前

cues.text: humans were already using sharpened flint to remove bits of rotten teeth.
cues.en: humans were already using sharpened flint to remove bits of rotten teeth.
cues.zh: 考古遺跡顯示，大約一萬四千年前 人類已用磨尖的燧石去除爛牙 古代人甚至做出了簡易的牙鑽

cues.text: Ancient humans even made rudimentary drills to smooth out the rough holes left behind
cues.en: Ancient humans even made rudimentary drills to smooth out the rough holes left behind
cues.zh: 古代人甚至做出了簡易的牙鑽 用來磨平粗糙的蛀孔 並且使用蜂蠟來填塞蛀洞 就像現代的填料

cues.text: and beeswax to plug cavities, like modern-day fillings.
cues.en: and beeswax to plug cavities, like modern-day fillings.
cues.zh: 並且使用蜂蠟來填塞蛀洞 就像現代的填料 很幸運的，今天 我們有更成熟的技術和工具

cues.text: Today, we have much more sophisticated techniques and tools, which is fortunate because we also need to contend with our more damaging,
cues.en: Today, we have much more sophisticated techniques and tools, which is fortunate because we also need to contend with our more damaging,
cues.zh: 很幸運的，今天 我們有更成熟的技術和工具 因為我們需要面臨更具破壞性的 嗜吃糖分的飲食方式

cues.text: sugar-guzzling ways.
cues.en: sugar-guzzling ways.
cues.zh: 嗜吃糖分的飲食方式

cues.text: After the Industrial Revolution, the human incidence of cavities surged
cues.en: After the Industrial Revolution, the human incidence of cavities surged
cues.zh: 嗜吃糖分的飲食方式 工業革命後，人類的蛀牙率激增 因為技術的突飛猛進

cues.text: because suddenly we had technological advances that made refined sugar cheaper and accessible.
cues.en: because suddenly we had technological advances that made refined sugar cheaper and accessible.
cues.zh: 因為技術的突飛猛進 使得精製糖更為便宜，容易獲得 你可能會難以置信 目前有 92％ 的美國成年人有蛀牙

cues.text: Today, an incredible 92% of American adults have had cavities in their teeth.
cues.en: Today, an incredible 92% of American adults have had cavities in their teeth.
cues.zh: 使得精製糖更為便宜，容易獲得 你可能會難以置信 目前有 92％ 的美國成年人有蛀牙 有些人容易蛀牙

cues.text: Some people are more susceptible to cavities due to genes that may cause certain weaknesses, like softer enamel,
cues.en: Some people are more susceptible to cavities due to genes that may cause certain weaknesses, like softer enamel,
cues.zh: 有些人容易蛀牙 是因為基因所導致的琺瑯質脆弱 但大多數人則是 因為吃了太多糖而蛀牙

cues.text: but for most, high sugar consumption is to blame.
cues.en: but for most, high sugar consumption is to blame.
cues.zh: 但大多數人則是 因為吃了太多糖而蛀牙 儘管如此，我們已發展出 減少齲齒的各種方法

cues.text: However, we have developed other ways of minimizing cavities besides reducing our intake of sugar and starch.
cues.en: However, we have developed other ways of minimizing cavities besides reducing our intake of sugar and starch.
cues.zh: 但大多數人則是 因為吃了太多糖而蛀牙 儘管如此，我們已發展出 減少齲齒的各種方法 除了降低糖和澱粉的攝取量

cues.text: In most toothpastes and many water supplies, we use tiny amounts of fluoride.
cues.en: In most toothpastes and many water supplies, we use tiny amounts of fluoride.
cues.zh: 在大多數的牙膏和飲用水中 也新增了微量的氟化物 可以強化牙齒、促進琺瑯質的生長

cues.text: That strengthens teeth and encourages the growth of enamel crystals
cues.en: That strengthens teeth and encourages the growth of enamel crystals
cues.zh: 可以強化牙齒、促進琺瑯質的生長

cues.text: that build up a tooth's defenses against acid.
cues.en: that build up a tooth's defenses against acid.
cues.zh: 可以強化牙齒、促進琺瑯質的生長 建立牙齒抗酸的防禦力

cues.text: When cavities do develop, we use tooth fillings to fill and close off the infected area,
cues.en: When cavities do develop, we use tooth fillings to fill and close off the infected area,
cues.zh: 建立牙齒抗酸的防禦力 一旦發生蛀牙 我們填補、密封牙齒的感染區

cues.text: preventing them from getting worse.
cues.en: preventing them from getting worse.
cues.zh: 我們填補、密封牙齒的感染區 防止它繼續惡化

cues.text: The best way to avoid a cavity is still cutting down on sugar intake
cues.en: The best way to avoid a cavity is still cutting down on sugar intake
cues.zh: 避免蛀牙的最佳辦法 仍然是減少糖分的攝取

cues.text: and practicing good oral hygiene to get rid of the bacteria and their food sources.
cues.en: and practicing good oral hygiene to get rid of the bacteria and their food sources.
cues.zh: 避免蛀牙的最佳辦法 仍然是減少糖分的攝取 並保持良好的口腔衛生 以去除細菌和他們的食物來源 這包括定期地刷牙

cues.text: That includes regular tooth brushing, flossing, and avoiding sugary,
cues.en: That includes regular tooth brushing, flossing, and avoiding sugary,
cues.zh: 這包括定期地刷牙 使用牙線 避開含糖、澱粉食物

cues.text: starchy, and sticky foods that cling to your teeth between meals.
cues.en: starchy, and sticky foods that cling to your teeth between meals.
cues.zh: 避開含糖、澱粉食物 還有那些會在兩餐之間 附著於牙齒的粘性食物

cues.text: Gradually, the population of sugar-loving microbes in your mouth will decline.
cues.en: Gradually, the population of sugar-loving microbes in your mouth will decline.
cues.zh: 還有那些會在兩餐之間 附著於牙齒的粘性食物 如此，口中的嗜糖微生物數量 就會逐漸減少 和以前的穴居人不一樣

cues.text: Unlike the cavemen of yesteryear, today we have the knowledge required to avert a cavity calamity.
cues.en: Unlike the cavemen of yesteryear, today we have the knowledge required to avert a cavity calamity.
cues.zh: 和以前的穴居人不一樣 今天我們有避免蛀牙所需的知識 我們只需實踐它

cues.text: We just need to use it.
cues.en: We just need to use it.
cues.zh: 今天我們有避免蛀牙所需的知識 我們只需實踐它
